1.consolidated_definition: soc. Estilo de vida. Modo de vida típico de un individuo, grupo o cultura. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. La colección de Boris Becker , que asociará lifestyle y vestimenta deportiva, será fabricada y distribuida por la empresa Pro-Sport y comercializada en grandes cadenas de tiendas deportivas y por correspondencia
1.en_consolidated_definition: Lifestyle. Style of life. Mode of living typical of an individual, group or culture. Raw anglicism, infrequently used. The collection by Boris Becker, which associates lifestyle and sports attire, will be manufactured and distributed by Pro-Sport and marketed in large sporting goods chains and through mail-order.
